# Configuring Splash Screen in Expo (2025-04-20 16:00:01)

_**User**_

add in support for a splash screen, using the poppy-cartoon-no-bg.png image. the splash screen should have a light background. it should look pretty similar to the welcome screen

here's an example from expo documentation
{
  "expo": {
    "plugins": [
      [
        "expo-splash-screen",
        {
          "backgroundColor": "#232323",
          "image": "./assets/images/splash-icon.png",
          "dark": {
            "image": "./assets/images/splash-icon-dark.png",
            "backgroundColor": "#000000"
          },
          "imageWidth": 200
        }
      ]
    ]
  }
}


---

Now I'll update your `app.json` to include the splash screen configuration. I'll use the same light background color as your welcome screen (`#FFF8E8`) and the poppy-cartoon-no-bg.png image.

```diff
+           "resizeMode": "contain"
+         }
+       ]

```

---

I've added the splash screen configuration to your `app.json` with the following settings:
- Used the same light background color (`#FFF8E8`) as your welcome screen
- Set the image to `poppy-cartoon-no-bg.png`
- Set the image width to 120 pixels to match the size used in your welcome screen
- Added `resizeMode: "contain"` to ensure the image maintains its aspect ratio

The splash screen will now show when your app starts up, displaying the Poppy cartoon image on a light background that matches your welcome screen's aesthetic. The image will be centered and properly sized.
